data_type: actual independent E2 full100 feedback, derived analysis
limits: Total flips include repeated back-and-forth events; no stepwise group identities are provided, so exact globally unique groups switching inside minibatches cannot be recovered.
Endpoint unique counts omit switches that reverse within the same epoch.
Changes in relative E2/E4 factors combine learned absolute E2 changes and dynamic E4 source changes.
No causal accuracy attribution or freeze outcome can be inferred from this single historical run.
freeze_interpretation: Freezing phi from epoch50 is a meaningful controlled continuation because absolute E2 exponents still change afterward; it removes the late E2 rounding switches while E4 source codes/scales, weights and BN continue adapting. It cannot guarantee an accuracy improvement and is not the same intervention as freezing a relative offset.
